gates.text: Own the measurement story.
A sustained metric-improvement loop uses [hillclimb](#hillclimb), not this one-off fix.
Capture a baseline trace on the matching authorized control surface.
Vet the baseline and every reported number with [benchmark-checklist](workflows.md#benchmark-checklist).
Profile outside reported measurement runs.
Pin workload, versions, tuning, error counts, and completed work.
Run [how](workflows.md#how) to ground mechanism-specific hypotheses.
Try the performance mantras in order, cheapest first: stop unused work; do it without repeating it; do it less; do it later; do it when the user is not waiting; do it concurrently; do it cheaper.
Stop when an earlier mantra meets the target.
Do not claim a ceiling without running the workload.
Plan from the trace.
A change crossing a function boundary completes [architect](workflows.md#architect) first.
Resolve `perf-issue` with `pstack_route` and give a scoped owner the emitted native `sessions_spawn` arguments.
Review its diff yourself.
Required independent phases that cannot run are BLOCKED, not sequential parent substitutes.
Verify each attempt before the next.
Capture a post-fix trace under the same conditions, parse both artifacts into queryable measurements, and compare them.
Re-run correctness gates and equivalent interleaved samples, including the end-to-end path and the changed component's share.
No measured delta is established by code inspection, a missing artifact, an inconclusive result, or the wrong surface.
Cite the measurement and linked artifacts in the PR only when publication is authorized under [opening-a-pr](#opening-a-pr).
**Reply.** Baseline, post-fix value, units, delta, run count and spread, limiter, and both trace or comparison artifact paths.
State inconclusive and its cause when the number is not supported.
